title: Build HTTP middleware chain in Go — 3 turns
description: Build a composable HTTP middleware chain: logging middleware in turn 1, auth middleware in turn 2, chain composition in turn 3.

task_spec.prompt: Implement the `Logging(logger)` middleware in `server/middleware.go`. It should wrap the handler using a `responseWriter` (or `httptest.ResponseRecorder`-style type) to capture the status code, then log `METHOD PATH STATUS` to the logger after calling the next handler. Use a simple wrapper that captures WriteHeader. Run `go test ./...`.
followup_prompts: Good. Now add input validation and error handling: implement the `Auth(secret)` middleware — parse the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header, compare to secret, and if missing or mismatched return `http.StatusUnauthorized`. Run `go test ./...` and fix any failures.

Run `go test ./...` to verify everything including Chain composition. Implement `Chain(middlewares...)` — apply middlewares in reverse order so the first in the list is outermost. Fix any failures and confirm all 5 tests pass.
success_criteria: Logging middleware logs method, path, and status code
Auth middleware allows requests with correct Bearer token
Auth middleware rejects requests with missing/wrong token (401)
Chain composes middlewares so first-listed is outermost
